en: Now I want to talk about some other things I learned after spending some more time with her.
zh: 现在我想聊聊和她相处更久之后，我又学到的一些事情。

en: When I first got her, I actually had a collar on her with a bell and I thought that was such a great idea, right?
zh: 刚开始接她回来的时候，我给她戴了一个带铃铛的项圈，当时我觉得这个主意棒极了，对吧？

en: Because she was just so tiny.
zh: 因为她真的太小了。

en: She was just like a little rat that I was nervous that I would step on her because again, she was just so tiny.
zh: 她就像一只小老鼠一样，我真的担心自己会踩到她，因为她实在太小了。

en: But actually having bells on collars can be really, really bad for their hearing.
zh: 但其实，项圈上带铃铛对它们的听力真的非常不好。

en: So right when I found that out, I took it off.
zh: 所以我一发现这点，就立刻把它取下来了。

en: I also learned that I don't want to scoop up her pee and her poo anymore.
zh: 我还意识到我不想再铲她的尿和便便了。

en: I was getting so over it, so pretty early on, I actually invested into a litter robot, which is an automatic litter box.
zh: 我已经受够了，所以很早的时候我就投资买了一个自动猫砂盆，也就是所谓的“litter robot”。

en: It helps me save a lot of money on litter because I'm not scooping out too much.
zh: 它帮我省了很多猫砂钱，因为不会铲掉太多。

en: It just takes out the parts that need to be taken out.
zh: 它只会把需要清理的部分处理掉。

en: It's definitely the best thing I've ever bought for her and for me because yeah, I was getting really, really sick of scooping everything up and I just didn't like it.
zh: 这是我为她也是为自己买过的最棒的东西之一，因为我真的很厌烦天天铲猫砂，真的一点都不喜欢。

en: I also heard from my other cat mom friends that using these little pellets or something like that is a lot better than the traditional sandy litter.
zh: 我还听别的猫奴朋友说，用那种小颗粒猫砂或类似的东西比传统的沙状猫砂要好很多。

en: If you don't want to get a litter robot just yet, I would look into that.
zh: 如果你暂时不打算买自动猫砂盆，我建议可以考虑这个。

en: I actually decided to get her spayed as soon as possible.
zh: 我还决定尽早给她做绝育。

en: So after you're done with all of that, I would actually recommend using a fluffy cone.
zh: 所以等你也做完这一切之后，我建议你给她戴一个毛绒项圈。

en: They initially give you this big plastic one and I feel like that's just really uncomfortable for them.
zh: 最开始医院会给你一个大塑料项圈，我觉得那个真的很不舒服。

en: It's hard for them to eat, go to the bathroom.
zh: 她戴着很难吃东西、上厕所。

en: So I would recommend using a little fluffy cone because they can use it as a pillow.
zh: 所以我建议换一个毛绒的项圈，她还可以当枕头用。

en: Initially, I actually got her this little suit that I thought would be perfect so she would have range of motion on her neck.
zh: 最开始我还给她买了一个小衣服，我觉得很完美，因为这样她脖子就可以自由活动了。

en: I put it on her and I thought it was going to be so cute.
zh: 我给她穿上，觉得她穿起来肯定很可爱。

en: Like she was in a little onesie and she started limping.
zh: 就像穿着连体衣一样，结果她开始一瘸一拐地走。

en: And I was like, oh my God, there's no way like something went wrong in the surgery.
zh: 我当时想，天哪，不会是手术出了什么问题吧。

en: She's hurt.
zh: 她是不是受伤了。

en: I need to take her to the vet.
zh: 我得带她去看兽医。

en: I was so, so nervous.
zh: 我超级紧张。

en: I thought she like sprained her ankle or something.
zh: 我还以为她是脚踝扭到了之类的。

en: I don't know.
zh: 我也不知道。

en: But then I took her to the vet and they just told me that she was being dramatic and that she didn't like the suit.
zh: 但后来我带她去看兽医，他们只是告诉我她太戏精了，她就是不喜欢那件衣服。

en: So the fluffy cone went back on.
zh: 所以我又给她戴回了毛绒项圈。

en: I also learned that cats are very, very simple creatures.
zh: 我还发现猫其实是非常非常简单的动物。

en: They don't need anything super fancy and all of that.
zh: 它们并不需要特别花哨的东西。

en: They're honestly happy with anything that they can play with.
zh: 只要能玩，它们其实都很开心。

en: Like at first, I built her this cat tree and I was so excited that she would love it so much and all that stuff.
zh: 像我一开始还给她搭了个猫爬架，我超兴奋地以为她会特别喜欢，什么的。

en: It took her like a couple of weeks to actually like lay on top of any of these flowers.
zh: 结果她花了好几周才真正愿意躺在这些“花朵”上面。

en: And she just recently actually started going in there.
zh: 她其实是最近才开始进去玩的。

en: And I've had this for probably like six months or something like that.
zh: 这个猫爬架我大概已经买了有六个月了。

en: And she only started going in there like last week.
zh: 她是上个星期才开始进去的。

en: So it does take time for them to get assimilated to some things.
zh: 所以猫适应一些东西确实是需要时间的。

en: And I think a tried and true toy and little burrow for them to be in is a cardboard box or a little shoe box or something like that.
zh: 我觉得百试不爽的玩具或躲藏地就是纸箱，或者鞋盒之类的小箱子。

en: I actually get a lot of PR, which I'm so grateful for.
zh: 我其实收到了很多赞助包裹，真的非常感激。

en: Thank you so much.
zh: 谢谢谢谢。

en: But I actually have like a lot of boxes around the house and it looks so horrible.
zh: 但我家里真的有很多纸箱，家里看起来一团糟。

en: But she has an attachment to this one box and I can't find it in my heart to throw it away.
zh: 但她对其中一个箱子特别有感情，我实在下不了决心把它扔掉。

en: But she loves this box so much and it looks so I'm just looking at it right now.
zh: 她太喜欢那个箱子了，我现在正看着它，看起来真的很……
